#
# Pre-deployment validation script
# Reads .env.test and confirms all required environment variables are set
#

set -e

ENV_FILE=".env.test"
MISSING_VARS=()
EMPTY_VARS=()

if [[ ! -f "$ENV_FILE" ]]; then
    echo "Error: $ENV_FILE not found"
    exit 1
fi

echo "Validating environment variables from $ENV_FILE..."
echo ""

while IFS= read -r line || [[ -n "$line" ]]; do
    # Skip empty lines and comments
    [[ -z "$line" || "$line" =~ ^[[:space:]]*# ]] && continue

    # Extract the variable name (everything before the first '=')
    var_name="${line%%=*}"

    # Skip if no variable name found
    [[ -z "$var_name" ]] && continue

    # Check if the variable is set in the current environment
    if [[ -z "${!var_name+x}" ]]; then
        MISSING_VARS+=("$var_name")
    elif [[ -z "${!var_name}" ]]; then
        EMPTY_VARS+=("$var_name")
    else
        echo "  [OK] $var_name"
    fi
done < "$ENV_FILE"

echo ""

# Report results
EXIT_CODE=0

if [[ ${#MISSING_VARS[@]} -gt 0 ]]; then
    echo "Missing environment variables:"
    for var in "${MISSING_VARS[@]}"; do
        echo "  [MISSING] $var"
    done
    EXIT_CODE=1
fi

if [[ ${#EMPTY_VARS[@]} -gt 0 ]]; then
    echo "Empty environment variables:"
    for var in "${EMPTY_VARS[@]}"; do
        echo "  [EMPTY] $var"
    done
    EXIT_CODE=1
fi

if [[ $EXIT_CODE -eq 0 ]]; then
    echo "All required environment variables are set."
else
    echo ""
    echo "Deployment validation failed. Please set all required environment variables."
fi

exit $EXIT_CODE

#
# Deployment script
# Validates config and sends it to the orchestrator before deploying
#

set -e

ENV_FILE=".env.test"
ORCHESTRATOR_URL="http://localhost:47301/api/deploy-config"

# Validate environment first
echo "Running pre-deployment validation..."
./validate-env.sh

echo ""
echo "Sending config to deployment orchestrator..."

# Convert .env.test to JSON and POST to orchestrator
# Reads key=value pairs and builds a JSON object
json_payload="{"
first=true

while IFS= read -r line || [[ -n "$line" ]]; do
    # Skip empty lines and comments
    [[ -z "$line" || "$line" =~ ^[[:space:]]*# ]] && continue

    # Extract key and value
    key="${line%%=*}"
    value="${line#*=}"

    # Skip if no key found
    [[ -z "$key" ]] && continue

    # Add comma separator after first entry
    if [[ "$first" == true ]]; then
        first=false
    else
        json_payload+=","
    fi

    # Escape special characters in value for JSON
    escaped_value=$(printf '%s' "$value" | sed 's/\\/\\\\/g; s/"/\\"/g; s/\t/\\t/g')
    json_payload+="\"$key\":\"$escaped_value\""
done < "$ENV_FILE"

json_payload+="}"

# POST to orchestrator
response=$(curl -s -w "\n%{http_code}" -X POST \
    -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
    -d "$json_payload" \
    "$ORCHESTRATOR_URL")

    echo "Config sent successfully (HTTP $http_code)"
else
    echo "Failed to send config to orchestrator (HTTP $http_code)"
    echo "Response: $body"
    exit 1
fi
